zh.bpChange: 与上一周期相比，平均收缩压{upper}，舒张压{lower}。
zh.sparseBp: 本期有 {span} 血压记录，上期有 {previousSpan}。两期各满 3 天，就能比较平均血压的变化。
zh.noBp: 本期有穿戴记录。记下同一天的血压，就能放在一起看。
zh.pairedChange: 在同时记录血压和{metric}的日子里，平均收缩压{upper}，{metric}日均从{prior}变为{value}（上期 {previousSpan}，本期 {span}）。
zh.pairedDay: {date} 同时记录了两项数据。当天平均血压为 {bp} mmHg，{metric}为{value}。
zh.pairedDays: 在同时有两项记录的 {days} 天里，平均血压为 {bp} mmHg，{metric}日均为{value}。
zh.contextChange: 按有记录的日子，{metric}日均从{prior}变为{value}。
zh.contextOnly: 本期有 {span} 的{metric}记录，日均为{value}。
zh.differentDates: 本期的穿戴记录和血压记录在不同日期，可分别查看。
zh.pairedAlignedChange: 在同一批血压记录日里，{metric}日均从{prior}变为{value}（上期 {previousSpan}，本期 {span}）。

en.bpChange: Compared with the previous period, average systolic pressure {upper} and diastolic pressure {lower}.
en.sparseBp: You recorded blood pressure on {span} this period and {previousSpan} last period. A comparison needs three recorded days in each.
en.noBp: You have wearable data for this period. Add a blood pressure reading on the same day to see them together.
en.pairedChange: On days with both readings, average systolic pressure {upper}. Average {metric} was {prior} last period and {value} this period, based on {previousSpan} and {span} of paired readings respectively.
en.pairedDay: On {date}, average blood pressure was {bp} mmHg and {metric} averaged {value}.
en.pairedDays: Across the {days} days with both readings, blood pressure averaged {bp} mmHg and {metric} averaged {value}.
en.contextChange: Across recorded days, average {metric} was {prior} last period and {value} this period.
en.differentDates: The wearable and blood pressure readings fall on different dates this period.
en.pairedAlignedChange: On those same blood pressure days, average {metric} was {prior} last period and {value} this period, across {previousSpan} and {span} respectively.
